name: GROKD deposit contract unauthenticated updatePool
summary: The GROKD LP-staking contract's implementation exposed updatePool without a caller check, letting anyone overwrite a pool's reward schedule. After staking 1 LP, the attacker raised pool 0's rewardPerBlock to an enormous value and called reward() in the same transaction, collecting almost the contract's whole GROKD reward balance, then sold it.
notes: The upgrade to 0xec61196d is the last before the exploit; later pool state changes are user deposits and withdrawals. The 1-LP stake (0x383dbb44) is setup; no other caller took more than about 100 GROKD from the contract.

GROKD has no market price and the attacker's own sells moved the pair, so the stolen GROKD is valued at the 157.67 BNB the five campaign sells paid the attacker (rule 15); the pair's gross BNB loss in those sells, 168.78 BNB, also includes the token's sell tax.
